# EnTT

ShinkouEngine vendors the EnTT single-include distribution under `third_party/entt/entt`.

- Version: `v3.16.0`
- Source: https://github.com/skypjack/entt/tree/v3.16.0/single_include/entt
- License: MIT, as published by the EnTT project.

The engine exposes `shinkou::ecs::Registry` and keeps EnTT types internal to the ECS implementation.
